briefing.title: Release tooling buyers move to bundles
briefing.body:
Two of Acme's rivals now sell release checks inside a bigger bundle, and buyers on Reddit and X are asking for one bill.

## Changes

- Northwind bundled checks with its CI plan.

## Signals

- Pricing complaints doubled week over week.

items.text: Northwind bundled release checks into its CI plan at no extra cost.
Globex cut its starter price to $19 a seat.
Pricing complaints about release tools doubled week over week.
Teams of 20 to 50 want one bill for CI and release checks.
Release tooling spend: about $1.2B a year, growing 18%.

answers.changed: Two rivals now bundle release checks into their CI plans.
answers.players: Northwind leads on bundles; Globex competes on price.

touched.statement: Teams under 50 pick the tool that ships with their CI
